(1) agile development teams face several challenges regarding the integration of quality requirements into their agile processes, (2) these challenges are caused by the lack of explicit guidance from agile methods regarding the integration of these requirements, and (3) a set of good practice can be used to overcome these challenges.
the quality requirements are often not explicit in large-scale distributed agile environments and therefore the quality requirements are usually not considered at the right time in the process.

understanding the current practice of quality requirements engineering in agile projects, identifying challenges, and providing good practices to address them.
